content: The application crashes whenever I try to export reports to PDF.
Highly intuitive dashboard! We got our whole sales team onboarded in under 10 minutes.
Searching through customer feedback is fast and responsive.
Can we get an option to customize the colors of themes in the reports?
The database sync failed with a 504 gateway timeout during peak usage.
Love the new dark mode design! It is very easy on the eyes.
The Slack integration fails to send notifications when new feedback is ingested.
We need a way to filter feedback by custom date ranges on the main trends chart.
Simple to configure and extremely snappy performance.
Is there an API endpoint where we can pull classified theme metrics programmatically?
